The '''Transel system''' was situated in the [[Southern Core]] portion of the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]]. It lay on the [[Shipwrights' Trace/Legends|Shipwrights' Trace]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]], which linked it to the [[Bassadro system/Legends|Bassadro]], [[Fondor system/Legends|Fondor]], and [[Surric system]]s.<ref name="TEA" /> The [[Star system/Legends|system]] contained the obscure, backwater terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Transel]],<ref name="SotG" /> which was a member of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]<ref name="KOTOR">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref> by [[3956 BBY]].<ref name="3956 BBY">''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' dates the events of ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]'' to [[3956 BBY]].</ref> At some point during the [[3959 BBY]]&ndash;3956 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]] [[Jedi Civil War]], the [[Sith military (Jedi Civil War)|military forces]] of the [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|empire]] founded by the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Revan/Legends|Darth Revan]] passed through the Transel system while advancing from the Fondor system to the Surric system.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Transel system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square L-13.<ref name="TEA" />
